messages:
incident-bot: Pager alert — elevated 5xx rate on ingress-gateway (svc=ingress-gateway). Current 5xx: 8% over baseline. Dash: https://dash.redwood/ingress/5xx spike. Incident ID: INC-20270317-01
sam: taking pager. joining call in 2m. starting quick triage.
jess: saw matching spike on outbound to model-pool-3 (egress lat p95 jumped). lots of upstream timeouts (504). pulling logs now.
sam: grabbing kvlogs filtered by corr id pattern. sample query: `jq -r 'select(.msg|test("corr=[a-z0-9]{9}"))' /logs/ingress/* | grep 504`
rahul: FYI we deployed proxy tweak at 2027-03-17T12:14Z that reduced upstream timeout to `2s` (was `10s`) and changed retry backoff to fixed 200ms.
sam: that's likely. found repeated request chains for corr=abc123def — gateway retried 3x, upstream hit timeout, each retry spawned new upstream request. snippet attached:
```
2027-03-17T12:18:05.123Z service=ingress-gateway corr=abc123def status=504 upstream=model-pool-3 rt=2.001s
2027-03-17T12:18:05.325Z service=ingress-gateway corr=abc123def retry=1 status=504 upstream=model-pool-3 rt=2.002s
2027-03-17T12:18:05.527Z service=ingress-gateway corr=abc123def retry=2 status=504 upstream=model-pool-3 rt=2.003s
```
jess: that pattern looks like retry amplification. gateway retries are synchronous so upstream gets hit N times for one client request. with upstream p95 already high, this cascades.
sam: mitigation applied: increased upstream timeout to 30s on proxy-ingress for model-pool-3 and disabled gateway-client retries for that route (config pushed at 12:21Z). rolling traffic back to fallback-pool for new requests.
monitoring-bot: Alert update — 5xx rate decreased from 8% -> 2.1% in 3m after mitigation (12:25Z).
maria: support: logging affected customers: acme-inc (500+ failed calls between 12:17-12:22), beta-app (dozens). I notified key contacts and opened support tickets.
jess: hypothesis: recent proxy change lowered timeout+fixed backoff -> with transient upstream slowness caused synchronous retries that amplified load and produced elevated 5xx. Evidence: deploy at 12:14, first 504 cluster at 12:18, corr chains showing 3 retries.
rahul: agree. next steps: 1) revert or roll forward proxy timeout/backoff change to previous config, 2) add jitter/exp backoff to retries, 3) add circuit-breaker if upstream p95 > threshold, 4) collect full trace set for corr ids and surface to RCA doc.
sam: collecting full kvlog bundle now and uploading to S3: s3://redwood-incident-archives/INC-20270317-01/kvlogs.tar.gz (permission restricted). Will handoff RCA to jess as lead. tagging jess for formal RCA doc. :thumbsup:
jess: taking RCA ownership. I'll assemble timeline, hypotheses, and postmortem. please include the deploy diff and the full trace set.
monitoring-bot: Incident INC-20270317-01 status: mitigated -> monitoring. escalation cleared.
sam: thanks team, will update incident ticket and create postmortem draft with timeline and customer impact numbers.
maria: I'll coordinate customer follow-ups and provide a consolidated impact summary for the postmortem.
